label: D1, mid-episode (trials ~38-82), when the policy at D1 moderately favours a2 (often right after a2 led rarely to S1)
explanation: Fires only at D1 (100% of mass). It never fires at GO or D2, never on episode trials < 30 or > 89, and almost never after an a1 choice. Rate peaks for trials 40-80, so there is a strong dependence on episode position (likely an internal clock signal). Behaviourally, 82% of mass falls on D1 steps whose previous trial was a2 -> S1 (rare). Those are mostly unrewarded (prev_reward 0 holds 88% of mass), and the agent then stays on a2. The remaining ~18% are rel -3 D1 steps where the previous trial lies outside the window, so the predicate cannot see it. The behavioural predicate D1 & prev_action==2 & prev_common==0 & ep_trial in [38,82) scores dev F1 0.58 (P 0.45, R 0.81). The recorded predicate swaps the behavioural condition for the model policy at D1 (choice logit a1-a2 < -4.44: a moderate a2 preference; the bin below -8.91 has zero activations, so this is a band). It covers the out-of-window cases too and scores dev F1 0.74 (P 0.69, R 0.80, mass recall 0.88). No future variables are used. Magnitude was not checked beyond the profile: top windows are mostly unrewarded a2->S1-rare predecessors while good=S2.
